name: vscode-swirl
description: Rich language support for the Swirl intermediate language (.swirl) featuring syntax highlighting, document formatting, semantic diagnostics, outline symbols, definition navigation, references, snippets, and parameter inlay hints.

swirl.inlayHints.parameterNames.enabled.description: Enable/disable parameter name inlay hints for Swirl predicates (exec, send, recv, move).

enumDescriptions: Display separate 'in:' and 'out:' tags before input and output datasets in exec flow
Display a single 'flow:' tag before the entire flow expression
swirl.inlayHints.execFlowStyle.description: Configure the parameter hint style for exec dataflow arguments.

swirl.inlayHints.locationTags.enabled.description: Enable/disable component name inlay hints inside location definitions (<loc, dataset, trace>).

scripts.vscode:prepublish: pnpm run compile && pnpm run bundle
scripts.test: node server/out/test/formatter.test.js && node server/out/test/features.test.js && node server/out/test/tier2.test.js && node server/out/test/inlay-hints.test.js
